name: apple-mail
title: Apple Mail clone
description: Apple Mail: Favorites, Smart Mailboxes and iCloud sections with rolling unread counts; a message list with unread dots, flags, attachments, previews and relative times; swipe actions, edit mode, search and an unread filter; a message view with a quoted thread and reply, flag, move, archive and trash; and a compose sheet. Three tiled columns on desktop, an overlay sidebar on iPad, a NavigationStack with large titles on iPhone. Composed from SplitView, NavigationStack, List, SheetContent, MarkdownEditor and DropdownMenu.
